user.title: Set up Dummy OS EMS
user.description: Select the existing Anker source and control entities. Physical control is only available through explicitly validated EMS paths.

electrical_setup.title: Electrical connection
electrical_setup.description: Choose how the battery is electrically connected. Without a dedicated circuit, Dummy OS EMS limits charging and discharging to 800 W.

power_limits.title: Power limits
power_limits.description: Set the maximum charge and discharge power. These limits are used centrally by the planner, Scheduler, Safety Guard and Execution Controller.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Dummy OS EMS
reconfigure.description: Change only setup-critical Anker source and control entities. Regular EMS settings are available under Configure.

abort.already_configured: Dummy OS EMS is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Dummy OS EMS has been updated and will reload.

error.power_above_profile_limit: The selected power limit exceeds the allowed limit for the selected electrical profile.

init.title: EMS settings
init.description: Manage the electrical limits and price settings for Dummy OS EMS. Import and export markup are added to the selected market price source; price resolution can be set to 60 or 15 minutes.

settings.title: EMS settings
settings.description: Manage the electrical limits and price settings for Dummy OS EMS. Import and export markup are added to the selected market price source; price resolution can be set to 60 or 15 minutes.

error.power_above_profile_limit: On a shared circuit, charging and discharging may not exceed 800 W.
